items.title: Japan real wages rise for sixth straight month, supporting BoJ rate hike (eventually) case
items.summary: Six consecutive months of real wage growth strengthens the argument for the Bank of Japan to continue normalising policy, particularly with base salary growth accelerating rather than the gain being driven mainly by volatile bonus payments.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 实际工资连续六个月实现增长，这进一步强化了日本央行应继续推进政策正常化的理由，尤其是考虑到基本工资的增长正在加速，而非主要由波动较大的奖金支付所推动。
items.summaryEn: Six consecutive months of real wage growth strengthens the argument for the Bank of Japan to continue normalising policy, particularly with base salary growth accelerating rather than the gain being driven mainly by volatile bonus payments.
